freeze_note: Intent records were frozen before retrieval inspection; labels were then adjudicated against the immutable matching-bundle corpus identity. This file is protected by explicit holdout access in the evaluator.
split_policy: twelve distinct scenario families per split; five independently phrased tasks per family; no family crosses the dev/holdout split
